summary: Composio integration tested end-to-end. All 12 backend pytest checks pass: unauthenticated 401, non-member 403, GET /toolkits returns available=true with 5 toolkits, POST /connect returns shaped Composio redirect_url + persists row with composio_user_id='{org_id}:{user_id}', bad toolkit -> 400, refresh works on own connection, cross-user disconnect -> 404, own disconnect removes row, auth_configs idempotent at 5 rows, per-org isolation correct. Frontend smoke pass — ConnectionsPanel renders all 5 toolkit cards, Gmail Connect fires POST /composio/connect, popup opens to https://platform.composio.dev/link/... and card flips to CONNECTING with Check-status button.
critical_code_review_comments: composio_integration.py is clean: lazy SDK import, idempotent ensure_auth_configs, per-(org,user) composio_user_id mapping, telemetry path into llm_calls already wired. No _id leakage (find() projections all use {'_id': 0}).

Routes properly gated with require_org_member; 404 mapping for cross-user disconnect goes through ValueError->HTTPException(404) — clean. Refresh route does its own composio_user_id ownership check before calling SDK — defense in depth.

Minor: composio_connect raises HTTPException(500) when SDK fails — fine, but consider mapping common Composio API errors (e.g. rate limit, invalid auth_config) to 502/503 rather than 500 for clarity. Not blocking.
execute_tool is intentionally not HTTP-exposed in v1 (per agent context note). Confirmed — no route mounts it.
